PH-239 is registered ready because its dependencies PH-210 and PH-230 are both done on this BASE; PH-240 stays proposed because PH-232 is still ready-not-done, and PH-241 stays proposed because it additionally needs PH-232 and PH-239. Each proposed task carries its concrete blockers in tasks.json and will be re-evaluated by PH-242. PH-157/PH-158 were deliberately not re-registered as new numbered slices: their canonical specs and proposed tasks already exist; PH-157's upstream is PH-110 (ready, not done) plus PH-142/PH-145/PH-150/PH-155 (proposed), and PH-158's upstream is PH-156/PH-157 (proposed) plus PH-110 (ready, not done), so freezing a slice now would duplicate contract authority; PH-242 carries the slice-evaluation step. No product code, migration, tests or governance-gate change is included, and no PH-237 file is touched by this slice.

review.reviewer: independent PH-238 planner reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: BLOCKER 1 - frozen PH-241 migration guidance is factually wrong: project/specs/PH-241.md line 22 says '迁移：settlement 下一号（PH-232 为 0003，若其先落则为 0004；按实际叶节点生成...）'. PH-232 actually adds two settlement migrations (0003_clearance_clearancereceipt.py and 0004_clearance_guards.py) and PH-241 depends on PH-232 being done, so at PH-241 implementation time the settlement leaf will be 0004 and the next migration number must be 0005, not 0004. Following the frozen text would either collide with an existing applied migration or force an out-of-contract correction. Fix: state 0003/0004 -> next 0005 (or drop the example and keep only the 'generate from the actual leaf' rule). This is a DoR migration-dimension defect in a frozen spec, not a runtime issue.

BLOCKER 2 - PH-157/PH-158 dependency analysis in report/handoff/PH-242 spec does not match tasks.json: BASE 3bc37d6 and HEAD both record PH-157 depends_on ['PH-150','PH-145','PH-142','PH-110','PH-155'] and PH-158 depends_on ['PH-156','PH-157','PH-110']; PH-110 ('将蓝白极简设计包整合为统一前端规范') is status=ready, NOT proposed and not done. The report summary (line 3) and deviations (line 36) say the 'entire upstream chain (PH-142/PH-145/PH-150/PH-155/PH-156)' is still proposed, which omits PH-110 and misattributes PH-156 (a PH-158 dependency) as part of PH-157's chain; the handoff line 14 lists PH-157 dependencies as PH-142/PH-145/PH-150/PH-155 (omitting PH-110) and then says '上游全部 proposed'; PH-242 spec line 8 lists the same five as the complete upstream and calls them all proposed. The no-new-slice decision still holds (PH-110 is ready-not-done and the other upstream tasks are proposed), but the frozen dependency analysis must be corrected to name PH-110 (ready, not done), PH-158's path (PH-156/PH-157/PH-110) and avoid claiming the whole chain is proposed.
